answer: With a Design mockup passing automated tests backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. One trellis proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of accepted work. A pulse alone is noise; a cedar of accepted work is a pattern the network can trust.
